pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Find this bow in world loot and read its expanded Alt tooltip. Pain shares damage across tethered targets; Grace buffs allies and gives protective cocoons; Bounty charges an airborne star with optional swing detonation; Chaos captures/refires projectiles and stacks draw speed.
